2610.10091.title: ExperienceIndex: Artifact-Grounded Memory
2610.10091.paper_summary: Knowledge-intensive tasks require answering many questions by reasoning about a shared corpus of artifacts (e.g., court cases, or scientific literature). As humans interact with these corpora, they naturally accumulate experiential knowledge about artifacts, enabling them to quickly identify the complete set of relevant artifacts for each new task. However, existing AI agents lack appropriate memory solutions to build or reuse such artifact-grounded experience, leading to lower answer quality and higher online cost. Existing memory solutions extract and reuse information from prior task-solving traces, but they primarily focus on user preferences, factual attributes, or abstract reasoning patterns rather than persistent artifact-specific knowledge. We introduce ExperienceIndex, a novel experience layer for AI agents that captures and reuses knowledge about artifacts based on prior reasoning traces. ExperienceIndex stores two complementary forms of experience: (i) single-artifact experiences that summarize an artifact's contribution to prior tasks and (ii) artifact-pair experiences that encode structural relationships discovered during past reasoning. Integrated as lightweight middleware, ExperienceIndex uses an experience retrieval mechanism to guide agents toward the complete set of relevant artifacts for new tasks, improving both answer quality and efficiency. Across diverse corpora and agentic solutions with different search frameworks, ExperienceIndex delivers consistent gains, raising answer quality by up to 11.0 points and reducing online dollar cost by up to 50.5%. We further demonstrate two benefits: (i) cross-task generalization, where experiences accumulated from text-to-SQL tasks transfer to factoid QA tasks over the same artifact corpus, and (ii) teacher-student learning, where experiences from a stronger model enable a weaker model to reach comparable performance.
2610.10091.paper_summary_zh: 知識密集型任務需要通過推理共享的文獻（例如，法庭案件或科學文獻）來回答許多問題。當人類與這些文獻互動時，他們自然會積累有關文獻的經驗知識，使他們能夠快速識別每個新任務的相關文獻的完整集合。 然而，現有的人工智慧代理缺乏適當的記憶解決方案來建立或重用這種基於文獻的經驗，導致答案質量較低和在線成本較高。現有的記憶解決方案從先前的任務解決痕跡中提取和重用信息，但它們主要集中於用戶偏好、事實屬性或抽象推理模式，而不是持久的文獻特定知識。我們介紹了ExperienceIndex，這是一種新穎的經驗層，用於人工智慧代理，基於先前的推理痕跡捕捉和重用有關文獻的知識。ExperienceIndex存儲兩種互補形式的經驗：（i）單一文獻經驗，總結文獻對先前任務的貢獻，和（ii）文獻對經驗，編碼在過去推理中發現的結構關係。作為輕量級中介軟體集成，ExperienceIndex使用經驗檢索機制引導代理朝向新任務的完整相關文獻集，提高答案質量和效率。在不同的文獻和具有不同搜索框架的代理解決方案中，ExperienceIndex提供了一致的增益，將答案質量提高最多11.0分，並將在線美元成本降低最多50.5%。我們進一步展示了兩個好處：（i）跨任務泛化，從文本到SQL任務中累積的經驗可以轉移到相同文獻集上的事實問答任務，以及（ii）教師-學生學習，來自更強模型的經驗使較弱模型達到可比較的性能。
